titleZh: Tesla 2023 年第三季度财报电话会议
summaryEn: Musk addresses third-quarter 2023 results, Cybertruck production-ramp concerns and high interest rates during the official investor Q&A.
summaryZh: 在官方投资者问答环节，马斯克谈到了2023年第三季度业绩、对 Cybertruck 产量爬坡的担忧以及高利率。

segments.textEn: It's sam.
segments.textZh: 是萨姆。

segments.textEn: Good afternoon everyone and welcome to Tesla's third quarter 2023 Q&A webcast. My name is Martin Vieja, VP of Invest Relations and I'm joined today by Elon Musk, Abaftaneja and a number of other executives. Our Q3 results were announced at about 3pm Central Time in the update that we published at the same link as this webcast. During this call we will discuss our business outlook and make forward looking statements. These comments are based on our predictions and expectations. As of today, actual events or results could differ materially due to a number of risks and uncertainties, including those mentioned in our most recent filings with the sec. During the question and answer portion of today's call, please limit yourself to one question and one follow up. Please use the raise hand button to join the question queue. But before we jump into the Q and A, Elon has some opening remarks.
segments.textZh: 大家下午好，欢迎参加Tesla 2023年第三季度问答网络直播。我叫Martin Vieja，是投资者关系副总裁。今天与我一同出席的有埃隆·马斯克、Abaftaneja以及其他多位高管。我们的第三季度业绩已于美国中部时间下午3点左右公布，相关更新发布在与本次网络直播相同的链接中。在本次电话会议期间，我们将讨论业务展望并作出前瞻性陈述。这些评论基于我们截至今天的预测和预期。由于多项风险和不确定性，包括我们最近向美国证券交易委员会提交的文件中提到的风险和不确定性，实际事件或结果可能存在重大差异。在今天电话会议的问答环节，请将问题限制为1个问题和1个后续问题。请使用举手按钮加入提问队列。但在进入问答环节之前，埃隆有一些开场发言。

segments.textEn: Elon thank you Martin. So, just a Q3 recap. Our last quarter was impacted by downtime for global factory upgrades that will help us reduce cost per vehicle as well as increase production. We remain focused on three main objectives which is the cost reduction of our products, investments in artificial intelligence and other growth projects like Optimus, and continued free cash flow generation. Regarding vehicle cost, our team was able to reduce the cost per vehicle further in Q3 despite headwinds from factory idle costs and ramp up of new factories and we believe there's still meaningful room for improvement there. Regarding autopilot and AI, our vehicles now driven over half a billion miles with FSD Beta, full self driving beta and that number is growing rapidly. We recently completed a 10,000 GPU cluster of H1 hundreds we think probably bringing it into operation faster than anyone's ever brought that much compute per unit time into production. Since training is the fundamental limiting factor on progress with full self driving and vehicle autonomy, we're also seeing significant promise with FSD version 12. This is the end to end AI where it's photon count in, controls out. Or really you can think of it as there's a just a large bit stream coming in and a tiny bit stream going out, compressing reality into a very small set of outputs, which is actually kind of how humans work. The vast majority of human data input is optics from our eyes and so we are like the car, photons in, controls out, with neural nets, just neural nets in the middle. So interesting to think about that we will continue to invest significantly in AI development as this is really the massive game changer and I mean success in this regard in the long term, I think has the potential to make Tesla the most valuable company in the world by far. If you have fully autonomous cars at scale and fully autonomous humanoid robots that are truly useful, it's not clear what the limit is regarding energy storage. We deployed 4 gigawatt hours of energy of storage products in Q3 and as this business grows, the energy division is becoming our highest margin business. Energy and service now contribute over half a billion dollars to quarterly profit. The Cybertruck. I know a lot of people are excited about the Cybertruck. I am too. I've driven the car. It's an amazing product. I do want to emphasize that there will be enormous challenges in reaching volume production with the Cybertruck and then in making the cybertruck cash flow positive. This is, this is simply normal for when you've got a product with a lot of new technology, any brand new vehicle program, but especially one that is as different and advanced as the cybertruck, you will have problems proportionate to how many new things you're trying to solve at scale. So I just want to emphasize that while I think this is potentially our best product ever, I think it is our best product ever. It is going to be require immense work to reach volume production and be cash flow positive at a price that people can afford. Often people do not understand what is truly hard. That is why I say prototypes are easy. Production is hard. People think it's the idea or you make a prototype, you design a car, and as soon as they're designing a car is just anyone can do it. It does require taste, it does require effort to design a prototype. But the difficulty of going from a prototype to volume production is like 10,000% harder to get to volume production than to make the prototype in the first place. And then it is even harder than that to reach positive cash flow. That is why there have not been new car startups that have been successful for 100 years, apart from Tesla. So, you know, I just want to temper expectations for Cybertruck. It's a great product, but financially it will take, I don't know, a year to 18 months before it is a significant positive cash flow contributor. I wish there was some way to that to be different, but that's, that's my best guess, You know, so it really, the demand is off the charts. We have over a million people who have reserved the car, so it's not a demand issue. But we have to make it and we need to make it at a price that people can afford. Insanely difficult things in Conclusion we continue to focus on ramping production while maintaining positive cash flow and we continue to target expect to have around 1.8 million vehicle deliveries. As stated earlier this year, the Tesla AI team is I think one of the world's best and I think it is actually by far the world's best when it comes to real world AI. I'll say that again, Tesla has the best real world AI team on Earth, period. And it's getting better. And lastly, I wanted to thank all of our employees who are making a lot of extra effort during uncertain times. Thank you very much for your hard work and the impact that you're making.
segments.textZh: 埃隆，谢谢你，Martin。那么，简单回顾一下第三季度。上个季度，我们受到全球工厂升级停工的影响，这些升级将帮助我们降低单车成本并提高产量。我们仍然专注于3个主要目标，也就是降低我们产品的成本、投资人工智能及Optimus等其他增长项目，以及持续产生自由现金流。关于车辆成本，尽管面临工厂闲置成本和新工厂产能爬坡带来的阻力，我们的团队仍然在第三季度进一步降低了单车成本，而且我们认为这方面仍有很大的改进空间。关于Autopilot和人工智能，我们的车辆现在使用FSD Beta，即完全自动驾驶测试版，已经行驶超过5亿英里，而且这个数字正在迅速增长。我们最近建成了一个由10,000个H1 hundreds GPU组成的集群，我们认为，我们让它投入运行的速度可能比任何人把如此多的单位时间算力投入生产的速度都快。由于训练是完全自动驾驶和车辆自主性取得进展的根本限制因素，我们也在FSD第12版上看到了巨大的希望。这是端到端人工智能，输入的是光子计数，输出的是控制。或者实际上，你可以把它理解为，有一股庞大的比特流进入，一股很小的比特流流出，把现实压缩成一组非常小的输出，而这其实有点像人类的运作方式。人类绝大多数的数据输入都是来自眼睛的光学信息，所以我们就像汽车一样，光子输入，控制输出，中间是神经网络，只有神经网络。这一点很有意思。我们将继续大力投资人工智能开发，因为这确实是一个巨大的游戏规则改变者。我的意思是，从长期来看，我认为这方面的成功有可能让Tesla遥遥领先地成为世界上最有价值的公司。如果你拥有大规模的完全自动驾驶汽车，以及真正有用的完全自主型人形机器人，那么储能的极限在哪里就不清楚了。我们在第三季度部署了4吉瓦时的储能产品，而随着这项业务增长，能源部门正成为我们利润率最高的业务。能源和服务现在为季度利润贡献超过5亿美元。Cybertruck。我知道很多人对Cybertruck感到兴奋。我也是。我开过这辆车。它是一款很棒的产品。我确实想强调，要实现Cybertruck的量产，然后让Cybertruck实现正现金流，将面临巨大的挑战。当你有一款采用大量新技术的产品时，这、这完全是正常现象；任何全新的车辆项目都会如此，尤其是像Cybertruck这样与众不同且先进的车辆，你试图大规模解决多少新问题，就会遇到与之成比例的问题。所以我只想强调，虽然我认为这可能是我们有史以来最好的产品，我认为它就是我们有史以来最好的产品，但要以人们负担得起的价格实现量产并获得正现金流，将会需要极其大量的工作。人们往往不明白什么才是真正困难的。这就是为什么我说原型很容易，生产很难。人们认为关键是想法，或者你做出一个原型、设计一辆车，而只要他们在设计一辆车，任何人都能做到。设计原型确实需要品位，也确实需要付出努力。但从原型走向量产，其难度比最初制作原型高出10,000%。然后，要实现正现金流甚至比这更难。这就是为什么100年来，除了Tesla之外，没有新的汽车初创公司取得成功。所以，你知道，我只是想降低大家对Cybertruck的预期。它是一款很棒的产品，但在财务上，我不知道，要过1年到18个月，它才会成为一个重要的正现金流贡献来源。我希望能有某种办法让情况有所不同，但那、那是我最好的估计。你知道，所以实际上，需求高得离谱。已经有超过100万人预订了这辆车，所以这不是需求问题。但我们必须把它制造出来，而且要以人们负担得起的价格制造出来。极其困难的事情。总之，我们继续专注于提高产量，同时保持正现金流，并继续以预计实现约180万辆汽车的交付量为目标。正如今年早些时候所说，我认为Tesla人工智能团队是世界上最优秀的团队之一，而且说到现实世界人工智能，我认为它实际上遥遥领先，是世界上最优秀的团队。我再说一遍，Tesla拥有地球上最优秀的现实世界人工智能团队。句号。而且它还在变得更好。最后，我想感谢我们所有在不确定时期付出大量额外努力的员工。非常感谢你们的辛勤工作以及你们正在产生的影响。

segments.textEn: Thank you very much. Elon and our CFO Ybuff have some opening remarks as well.
segments.textZh: 非常感谢。埃隆和我们的首席财务官Ybuff也有一些开场发言。

segments.textEn: Thanks Martin. Vehicle deliveries in Q3 outpaced production and we had yet another record quarter of profitability in our energy business. Congratulations to the Tesla team for their continued focus on operational excellence as we navigate through a period of economic uncertainty, higher interest rates and shifting consumer sentiment. As Elon mentioned, our Q3 operational and financial performance was impacted by planned downturns for our factory upgrades. This was necessary to allow for further factory improvements and production rate increases. Despite such factory shutdowns, our cost per vehicle decreased to approximately 37,500. We saw sequential decreases in material cost and freight. Reducing the cost of our vehicles is our top priority. On the operating expenses front, R and D expenses continue to rise due to cybertruck prototype builds and pilot production testing combined with spend on AI technologies like full self driving, Optimus and Dojo. We have and will continue to make investments in these areas and hence our capital expenditure and R and D will continue to grow in the near term. However, our focus is to continue making investments through positive cash flow from operations. This year itself, we have generated operating cash flows of approximately 8.9 billion and free cash flows of approximately 2.3 billion. Our other businesses are becoming more prominent on a standalone basis, with energy business leading the charge primarily from the growth in megapyte. Our services and other businesses on a year on year basis also continue to show positive momentum as we benefit from our growing fleet. As regards our pricing strategy, in addition to what we have shared before, I want to elaborate that most car buying happens with one or other form of financing and hence we also view pricing in terms of monthly costs for the customer and therefore as interest costs in the US have risen substantially, it has required us to adjust the price of our vehicles to keep the monthly cost in parity. We've tried to offset such adjustments via focus on Reducing cost. However, there is an inherent lag in cost reductions which in turn impacts margins to that extent. We recently announced a partner vehicle leasing program in the US whereby you can get a standard range model Y for as low as $399 a month. In conclusion, as we navigate through a challenging economic environment, we're focused on reducing costs, maximizing delivery volumes and continuing making investments in the future. In particular AI and other next generation platform. We believe this strategy positions us well for the long term. Once again, I would like to thank the Tesla team for their efforts in the last quarter.
segments.textZh: 谢谢你，Martin。第三季度的车辆交付量超过了产量，我们的能源业务又一次创下单季度盈利纪录。祝贺Tesla团队，在我们应对经济不确定性、利率上升和消费者情绪转变的时期，仍持续专注于卓越运营。正如埃隆提到的，我们第三季度的运营和财务表现受到了为工厂升级而计划停产的影响。为了进一步改进工厂并提高生产速率，这是必要的。尽管工厂进行了这些停产，我们的单车成本仍降至约37,500。我们看到材料成本和运费环比下降。降低车辆成本是我们的首要任务。在运营费用方面，由于Cybertruck原型车制造和试生产测试，加之在完全自动驾驶、Optimus和Dojo等AI技术上的支出，研发费用继续上升。我们已经并将继续在这些领域投资，因此短期内我们的资本支出和研发费用将继续增长。不过，我们的重点是继续利用经营活动产生的正现金流进行投资。仅今年，我们就产生了约89亿美元的经营现金流和约23亿美元的自由现金流。我们的其他业务作为独立业务正变得更加突出，其中能源业务主要受megapyte增长推动，处于领先地位。由于我们从不断扩大的车队中受益，我们的服务及其他业务同比也继续展现积极势头。关于我们的定价策略，除了此前分享的内容外，我还想进一步说明，大多数购车都会采用某种形式的融资，因此我们也会从客户每月成本的角度看待定价；所以，随着美国的利息成本大幅上升，我们不得不调整车辆价格，以使每月成本保持相当。我们一直试图通过专注于降低成本来抵消此类调整。不过，成本降低存在固有的滞后，而这也会相应影响利润率。我们最近宣布了美国的一项合作伙伴车辆租赁计划，通过该计划，你能以低至每月399美元的价格获得一辆标准续航版Model Y。总而言之，在应对充满挑战的经济环境时，我们专注于降低成本、最大化交付量，并继续投资于未来。尤其是AI和其他下一代平台。我们相信，这一策略使我们在长期内处于有利地位。再次感谢Tesla团队在上一季度付出的努力。

segments.textEn: Thank you very much. And now let's go to investor questions. The first investor question comes from Craig. How many cybertruck deliveries do you anticipate for 2024?
segments.textZh: 非常感谢。现在我们来回答投资者问题。第1个投资者问题来自Craig。你预计2024年会交付多少辆Cybertruck？

segments.textEn: It's difficult to make an accurate guess at this point. Going back to what I said earlier, that the ramp is going to be extremely difficult. And like I said, there's no way around that. If you try to make. If we just try to do some copycat vehicle design, of which there are literally 200 models that are slight variations on a theme in the combustion engine world, just distinctions without a difference, then it's really not that hard. But if you want to do something radical and innovative and something really special like the cybertruck, it is extremely difficult because there's nothing to copy. You have to invent not just the car, but the way to make the car. So the more uncharted the territory, the less predictable the outcome. Now I can say that if you say, well, where will things end up? I think we'll end up with roughly a quarter million cybertrucks a year. And I don't think we're going to reach that output rate next year. I think we probably reach it sometime in 2025. That's my best guess.
segments.textZh: 目前很难做出准确猜测。回到我之前所说的，产能爬坡将极其困难。而且就像我说的，这一点无法绕开。如果你试图制造。如果我们只是试图做某种模仿式的车辆设计，在内燃机领域里实际上有200种车型只是同一主题的轻微变体，只有区别却没有实质差异，那么事情确实没有那么难。但如果你想做出像Cybertruck这样激进、创新且真正特别的东西，那就极其困难，因为没有任何东西可以照搬。你不仅必须发明这辆车，还必须发明制造这辆车的方式。因此，涉足的领域越是未知，结果就越难预测。现在我可以说，如果你问，嗯，最终会达到什么水平？我认为我们最终会达到每年约25万辆Cybertruck。我不认为我们明年能达到这一产出速率。我认为我们可能会在2025年的某个时候达到。这是我最准确的猜测。

segments.textEn: Thank you. The second question is, can you provide a progress Update on the 4680 cell? Particularly progress towards performance improvements and cost savings outlined on battery day.
segments.textZh: 谢谢。第2个问题是，你能否介绍一下4680电芯的进展情况？尤其是在实现电池日所概述的性能改进和成本节省方面的进展。

segments.textEn: Thank you.
segments.textZh: 谢谢。

segments.textEn: Sure thing, Martin.
segments.textZh: 当然可以，Martin。

segments.textEn: Cell production in Texas increased 40% quarter over quarter. Congrats to the Texas team for producing their 20 millionth cell off of line one. Texas is now our primary 4680 facility. We're heavily focused on quality. Scrap is down 40% quarter over quarter with the increased volume and yield improvements. Cell costs consistently improved month over month within the quarter. Although we have a lot more work to do to achieve our steady state goals. And that is our priority. The Cybertruck cell, with 10% higher energy than our model Y Cell started production on line two in Texas this quarter. We convert to building 100% Cybertruck cells to simplify and focus the factory as we ramp all four lines in phase one over the next three quarters. Phase two of the Texas 4680 facility is currently under construction. The additional four lines incorporate further capital efficiencies over phase one and our target is for them to start producing in late 2024. Lastly, in Cato we're retooling to enable large scale pallet runs of our next generation cell designs. Cato's long term goal is to be the launch pad for new cells one generation ahead of our mass production facilities, enabling faster iteration and smoother ramp ups of new designs.
segments.textZh: 得州的电芯产量环比增长 40%。祝贺得州团队从 1 号生产线下线了第 2,000 万颗电芯。得州现在是我们主要的 4680 生产基地。我们高度专注于质量。随着产量增加和良率提升，废品率环比下降了 40%。本季度内，电芯成本逐月持续改善。尽管要实现我们的稳态目标，我们还有大量工作要做。而这正是我们的首要任务。能量比我们的 Model Y 电芯高 10% 的 Cybertruck 电芯，本季度已在得州的 2 号生产线上开始生产。在未来 3 个季度提升第一阶段全部 4 条生产线产能时，我们会转而制造 100% 的 Cybertruck 电芯，以简化工厂并使其聚焦。得州 4680 生产基地的第二阶段目前正在建设中。新增的 4 条生产线在第一阶段基础上进一步提高了资本效率，我们的目标是让它们在 2024 年末开始生产。最后，在 Cato，我们正在改造设备，以便对下一代电芯设计进行大规模托盘批次生产。Cato 的长期目标是成为新电芯的启动平台，比我们的量产设施领先 1 代，从而实现更快的迭代和更顺畅的新设计产能爬坡。

segments.textEn: Thank you. The next question from institutional investor is could you please provide an update on capacity expansion plans for companies factories in Berlin and Austin and the opening schedule of Gigafactory in Mexico
segments.textZh: 谢谢。下一位机构投资者的问题是，能否请你们介绍一下公司在柏林和奥斯汀的工厂产能扩张计划，以及墨西哥超级工厂的启用时间表？

segments.textEn: Berlin and Austin factory. The current priority is actually maximize the output from our existing lines by laser focus on efficiency improvement. As always, maintaining a high quality and reducing per unit cost will be as critical as growing production volume for Mexico. We're working on infrastructure and factory design in parallel with the engineering development of the new products that will be manufactured there. That's I can share for them.
segments.textZh: 柏林和奥斯汀工厂。目前的优先事项实际上是通过极度专注于效率提升，最大限度提高现有生产线的产量。与往常一样，在提高产量的同时，保持高质量和降低单位成本将同样关键。对于墨西哥，我们正在推进基础设施和工厂设计，同时进行将在那里生产的新产品的工程开发。这就是我能就它们分享的内容。

segments.textEn: In Mexico we're laying the groundwork to begin construction and doing all the long lead items. But I think we want to just get a sense for what the global economy is like before we go full tilt on the Mexico factory. I am worried about the high interest rate environment that we're in. I just can't emphasize this enough that the vast majority of people buying a car is about the monthly payment. And as interest rates rise, the proportion of that monthly payment, I.e. interest increases naturally. So that's. If interest rates remain high or if they go even higher, it's that much harder for people to buy the car. They simply cannot afford it. And we are tracking, I believe at this point for model Y to be the a selling car on earth, but not just in revenue but in unit volume. If you compare that to the other vehicles that are, you know, number two and number three and whatnot, they, they cost much less than our car. So you know, we're just hitting low of large numbers situations here. I know people want us to advertise and we are advertising. I think there is some, there's something to that. There is something to be gained on the advertising front. I don't think it's nothing but informing people of a car that is great that they cannot afford doesn't. Doesn't really help.
